summary: Master financial concepts with our course designed for non-financial managers. Learn to manage budgets, analyze financial statements, and drive success.
lede: Finance for non-financial managers helps operational and project managers connect day-to-day decisions with budgets, costs, cash and performance. Participants practise interpreting financial statements, building operating budgets and rolling forecasts, and explaining budget variances. They also work with contribution margins, working-capital forecasts and investment appraisal to prepare clear financial reports and decision briefs without taking on specialist accounting responsibilities.
audienceIntro: Financial management for non-financial managers is designed for professionals who own operational decisions, budgets, projects, or commercial outcomes without specialist accounting responsibilities. This foundation-to-intermediate course suits managers who need to translate business activity into reliable financial analysis.
prerequisites: No formal finance certification or accounting degree is required. You should bring a basic understanding of your organization’s products, services, costs, budgets, or operational targets. Microsoft Excel familiarity will help you complete the financial modelling exercises, while Power BI work remains at a guided dashboard-design level. You will not need to write code. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted forecasting and digital financial reporting are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application levels. The course does not promise production deployment of forecasting models or enterprise accounting-system configuration.
